tasks.name: monitor
tasks.prompt: One continuous premium corporate documentary shot. LOCKED OFF TRIPOD CAMERA. The camera is perfectly stationary for the entire clip, no zoom, no pan, no reframing. Preserve the exact initial composition, monitor or phone position, and all four screen corners throughout. The physical display is completely uniform dark neutral gray and stays perfectly blank; no text, no UI, no graphics. Never let a hand or face overlap any part of the display surface. Only natural human micro movements and subtle breathing. Anatomically normal adults and hands, understated calm acting, no speech, no captions. The seated woman looks at her desktop computer display and makes a small natural mouse movement with her right hand on the desk. She briefly shifts her fingers over the keyboard, maintaining her working posture and focus. The desktop monitor and desk remain absolutely still; preserve office architecture and lighting. We are observing real work over her shoulder, with the visible empty screen central to the shot.
